It's difficult to give advice when the premise is so vague, so here's some generic advice:

  • Don't make someone a priority if they only make you an option.
  • Super cheesy, but people do speak different "love languages". What's your girlfriend's? Speaking her language is a way to relight lost sparks. Is she fulfilling yours?
  • Don't get married if you have doubts.

Cheers.

Not enough detail to give specific advice. But I have a generic input;

She was 19 when you got together. As a young adult people grow and evolve at a fast pace compared to later in life (early thirties). Maybe she has grown apart from you, got new interests you do not partake in or found out that she is not ready for marriage just yet? Or maybe you have not grown at the same pace, if you were at similar places in life when you met. Or maybe you can't keep up with her needs/wants/desires/goals/ambition? Communicate with her, that is the only way to find out.
